newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-South Australia to sell Santos house.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-South Australia to sell Santos house.

text.p: Adelaide's landmark 30-storey office tower, Santos House, is to be sold following the completion of South Australia's biggest private sector office leasing deal, State treasurer Stephen Baker said on Tuesday.
Baker said in a statement the latest leasing arrangement with oil and gas producer Santos Ltd meant more than 94 percent of office space at the 91 King William Street building was let.
"The 30 storey tower is a South Australian landmark and will certainly attract a great deal of interest from both national and international buyers," he said.
The SA Asset Management Corp had appointed Jones Lang Wootten and Colliers Jardine as joint advisors on the sale, he said.
